Dehydrated Beetroot Flakes Supplier: Bulk Beetroot Flakes from India

Beetroot flakes give soup makers, snack producers, bakers and vegetable-mix packers a deep red color and an earthy-sweet taste without the mess of fresh roots. Tradenest Naturals is a dehydrated beetroot flakes supplier in India, serving food manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, HORECA suppliers, private label brands and importers. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The beetroots are washed, trimmed, sliced, dehydrated, inspected and packed under hygienic conditions. We offer bulk and wholesale supply, flexible packaging, OEM and private label packing, and export documentation support. Dehydrated beetroot flakes serve as an efficient, shelf-stable alternative to fresh root vegetables, cutting water weight while keeping the deep red color and earthy-sweet flavor. The flakes can be rehydrated, blended, ground or used in seasonings, soups, ready-to-cook meal kits, bakery goods and snack coatings. Many buyers also mill them further into beetroot powder or granules.

Product Overview & Specifications

Our dehydrated beetroot flakes are dried under controlled temperature and airflow, so they store at ambient temperature with no need for cold-chain transport. They are supplied as clean, free-flowing 4-8 mesh pieces. The standard material contains no additives unless a different formulation is agreed in writing. Packaging and private labeling can be matched to your end use.
  • Food-grade dehydrated beetroot pieces for commercial processing
  • Authentic deep red visual appearance with a natural, mildly sweet, earthy flavor
  • Suited to bulk purchasing, wholesale distribution and export
  • Flexible packaging options ranging from small retail pouches to industrial bulk sacks
  • Fully compatible with private-label, OEM, and custom food ingredient programs

Manufacturing and Processing Workflow

At Tradenest Naturals, production starts with careful raw material selection and inspection of each incoming lot. Fresh beetroots are sorted, washed to remove soil, trimmed and sliced into even flakes. The slices are then dehydrated under monitored temperature and airflow to bring moisture down while keeping the pieces intact. After drying, the flakes are cooled, sieved, visually checked and sealed in moisture-barrier, food-safe packaging. We work to written standard operating procedures (SOPs) covering hygiene, allergen management, moisture control, foreign matter removal, packing and batch traceability. Our team talks with your procurement and R&D staff when you need a particular rehydration behavior or color intensity. For larger programs, we offer supply planning and private label packaging.

Typical Technical Specifications

The values below are taken from the product specification sheet shared with every quotation. Color can vary slightly with the season's crop. If you need analytical results before dispatch, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.
  • Form: Dehydrated beetroot flakes or custom cut pieces
  • Mesh / Cut Size: 4-8 mesh
  • Moisture Content: ≤ 8%
  • Shelf Life: 12 months in sealed packaging
  • Color: Natural deep red to purple-red, depending on beetroot variety and drying
  • Flavor & Aroma: Characteristic clean, earthy, and mildly sweet beetroot profile
  • Additives: No added preservatives, artificial flavorings or synthetic colors

Quality Assurance, Food Safety, and Documentation

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. Our quality checks focus on raw material grading, hygienic processing, moisture control, visual sorting, batch tracking and sturdy export packaging. Before dispatch, we check appearance, color, aroma, cut size and moisture against the agreed specification. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Please tell us before order confirmation which documents your market needs, such as allergen declarations or a phytosanitary certificate. We will then confirm what can be supplied with the shipment.

Key Industrial Applications

Product developers like beetroot flakes because they store easily, bring strong natural color and mix well into many foods. They can be used as flakes after a short soak, or ground finer for blends and doughs.
  • Instant soup mixes, dried broths, stews and ready meals
  • Ready-to-cook (RTC) and ready-to-eat (RTE) dehydrated vegetable medleys
  • Savory seasoning blends, snack food dustings, and flavor premixes
  • Bakery items, artisanal crackers, whole-grain breads, fresh pasta, and noodles
  • Salad bowl inclusions, vegetable stuffings, fillings, and gourmet side dishes
  • Smoothie mixes, plant-based foods and colorful snack bars
  • Raw material for milling into beetroot powder or vegetable granules

Strategic Buyer Advantages

Buying dehydrated beetroot simplifies procurement, steadies inventory costs and gives you year-round supply that does not depend on the fresh harvest. With most of the water removed, the flakes take up far less storage space and keep for 12 months at ambient temperature when stored correctly. Buyers can easily select appropriate packaging formats to service retail, institutional, wholesale, or industrial manufacturing channels.
  • Extended ambient shelf life compared to perishable fresh beetroot
  • Savings on cold-chain logistics, warehousing and freight volume
  • Precise portion control, simplified transport, and streamlined inventory auditing
  • Consistent flake cut and density ensuring repeatable production runs
  • Flexible packaging and private label support
  • Better cost per kilo on high-volume and scheduled OEM orders

Packaging Formats and Shelf Life

We supply dehydrated beetroot flakes in versatile commercial weights including 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg configurations, as well as bulk bags for industrial users. Packaging materials feature food-grade inner liners, heavy-duty moisture-barrier pouches, PET jars, HDPE pails, or export-grade multi-layer paper bags. Customized branded packaging, private-label artwork printing, specialized cartons, palletization, and destination-specific crating can be arranged prior to production runs. Shelf life is 12 months from the date of manufacture when kept unopened in original moisture-barrier packaging under cool, dry, pest-free conditions. Lot codes and best-before dates are printed on every master carton. Each package features standardized labeling including product identification, batch numbers, net weights, manufacturing timelines, best-before dates, and storage protocols.

MOQ, Lead Times, Sampling, and Quotations

The minimum order quantity (MOQ) for our dehydrated beetroot flakes is 5 Kg. Samples are available on request, so you can evaluate the flakes before ordering. Custom packaging, printed OEM films and special formulations need extra planning, and we confirm the details after reviewing your requirements. Lead time is confirmed with each quotation, after specification sign-off and purchase order or payment confirmation. Custom formulations, printed packaging, third-party testing requested by the buyer or complex export paperwork may add time. To request a formal quotation or evaluation sample, please provide your target quantity, required mesh size or cut dimension, intended application, packaging preference, destination port, labeling needs, and any required compliance documents. Tradenest Naturals will reply with a clear commercial proposal for your application.

Why Partner with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals is a manufacturer and exporter that supports buyers beyond the basic sale. Our work covers dehydration, sieving, bulk packing, retail packing, OEM and private label packing, and custom ingredient development. Whether you are sourcing wholesale dehydrated beetroot flakes for broad distribution or developing a new consumer food product, our technical and sales teams work closely with you to align ingredient specifications with your exact commercial and operational goals. As a dehydrated beetroot flakes manufacturer and exporter in India, we offer transparent communication, batch traceability, clear documentation and B2B logistics that grow with you. Contact Tradenest Naturals today to discuss current market pricing, sample evaluations, specification sheets, packaging options and export schedules.
